headline: Apple and Amazon report after the bell.
detail: These are major tech players, and their earnings will set the tone for the broader tech market. Your QQQ and QQQI holdings, heavily weighted in these names, will react strongly to the results.
rec: No action needed now, but be ready to react to market open tomorrow based on these results.

headline: Chip stocks get major boosts from Microsoft earnings.
detail: This is positive news for your concentrated chip exposure (SMH, SOXL). Microsoft's strong performance suggests underlying demand for tech infrastructure, which benefits chipmakers.
rec: MSFT is on your scanner (entry 456.63-456.06, stop 454.68). Consider if this positive sentiment warrants a new position or adds to existing chip exposure.

headline: OpenAI cuts AI model prices.
detail: While potentially good for AI adoption long-term, this signals cost sensitivity among companies. It could put pressure on AI-related tech names if it suggests a slowdown in spending or increased competition.
rec: No direct trade, but keep an eye on how this impacts broader tech sentiment, especially for growth names in your portfolio.
